question: Does the unchanged longitudinally averaged JS profile retain a bilateral fit across a specifically localized missing rail while an ordered exact partition of its samples exposes the affected locations?
claimBoundary: Information loss by averaging only. Neither long nor short fits classify a path, establish per-pixel rail continuity, endpoint ownership, physical width, confidence or renderer/AA identity.

execution.permittedNow: Declare protocol, inspect source/contracts, hash sources and fixture bytes; no call to composition, source-pixel runner, profileAt, edgePairOf or Dev72 operations.
execution.futureEntryPoint: Existing experiments/capability-discovery/composition/recipe.mjs#runComposition on each generator-returned composition input, exactly once per case after root release; use existing preserveNonFinite for JSON.

fixedGeometry.matchedAblation: long-at-short-05 and short-05 have identical origin184,160, heading, pixels, bank, masks and edge settings; only t0/t1 differ. Dev72 fixed-origin observations are therefore duplicated controls, not evidence corroborating a change in profile window.

cases.predicate: 145 <= y && y <= 174, for all integer x
cases.role: Positive mechanism control; exposed, not heldout
cases.predictedObservation: At bank30, long and all12 short windows retain finite positive bilateral fits with identical raw profiles and fits. Raw midpoint need not be0 because pixel occupancy is asymmetric about y160. Off-bank24/36 rows remain unselected and fully retained.
cases.hardFalsifier: Any long/short bank30 null/nonfinite fit, or unequal long/short profiles/visible fractions after accounting for counts192 versus16, falsifies this proposed intact baseline. Do not tune raster/window/settings.

cases.role: Primary new localized one-sided rail-loss ablation;32 columns affected, exactly two short windows
cases.predictedObservation: At bank30 the long profile retains a positive bilateral fit, while short05 and06 lose the falling upper-normal rail within +/-30 and return null fits; the other10 short windows match intact. Within the matched anchor184 sensor observation cannot depend on long versus short window. Raw long means for offsets +16..+30 are107.5, versus100 intact; short05/06 are145 there. Lower rail stays unchanged. These exact pixel-average predictions are not fitted-edge numeric predictions.
cases.hardFalsifier: The proposed demonstration fails if bank30 long fit is absent/nonpositive/nonfinite, if either predeclared defect short has a finite positive bilateral fit, or if any nondefect short differs from intact. If raw mean predictions fail, suspect input/generator/source support and mark experiment invalid before interpretation; preserve all outputs. A fit from an endpoint artifact is a falsifier, never silently relabelled a physical rail.
cases.newRelativeToE302: E302 used sinusoidally varying full width at5 spaced stations and a full vertical crossing, not this32-column one-sided bright extension with12 exactly partitioning windows and a same-origin long/short pair. No old receipt is relabelled as a new measurement.

cases.role: Reused semantic non-identifiability guard, not primary novelty
cases.predictedObservation: All declared CV sampling footprints lie in the straight capsule core. Complete raw learner rows, all profiles, observations, fits, paired-rail/midpoint fields equal intact, while full RGBA differs outside support. Even all12 short fits cannot identify path semantics.
cases.hardFalsifier: Any raw CV field difference versus intact (excluding image/frame/provenance metadata) falsifies the declared footprint-equivalence guard; inspect and preserve it, with no added semantic inference. Equality itself falsifies any claim this experiment universally rejects organic components.

cases.role: Reused crossing-ambiguity guard, not primary novelty
cases.predictedObservation: Bank30 long profile may retain bilateral edges from the160 noncrossing columns, while short05/06 are flat145 across all241 normals and lack bilateral fits. Ordered shorts locate an unsupported crossing interval but do not resolve continuation or endpoint ownership.
cases.hardFalsifier: No positive bank30 long fit, a positive bank30 fit in either flat central short, or a changed noncrossing short falsifies this proposed mechanism control. None of these outcomes can promote path identity.

retention.allRows: 4 cases x13 stations x3 requested widths =156 candidate rows, plus all learner rows; no best-width filtering.
rawFields: all observation lanes/interior/rail/combined fields and raw railMode
retention.numericPolicy: Use existing preserveNonFinite JSON replacer. Null fit staysnull; missing/nonfinite midpoint never becomes0. Nonfinite diagnostics stay numberKind/value objects. Unsupported or input-invalid rows stay UNKNOWN/NOT_EXECUTED, not failed physical paths.
retention.orderedEvidence: Keep short rows in declared x order including gaps. A mean of short fits, support fraction or selected successful subset cannot replace the ordered sequence. No added detector, threshold, calibration, score weighting, arange width expansion, forced recentering or acceptance policy.

priorCounterexamples.lesson: Ragged averaging hides variation; crossing hides local failure; capsule duplicates ribbon. Existing results motivate but do not measure the new localized control.
Ellipse can uniquely win an uncalibrated width and transfer fails; ties/all-hidden learner returns are diagnostic only.
Few bends, equal length and zero conditional midpoint do not choose crossing ownership; failed pairs remain UNKNOWN.
Tiny profile roundoff can jump strict edge selections; no tolerance relaxation or universal translation invariance.
Rendering recorded seam evidence is not a fresh CV replay.
Support abstention is UNKNOWN; any future ROI change must be separately declared, with no adaptive rerun.
